title: Surface Japan
subtitle: Short Notes of a Swift Survey
omitted_from_reading: The half-title is in the JSON only.
notes_on_text: Every text page of the book is printed inside a frame of bamboo canes, with one or two small figure drawings “after Hokusai” in its margins, used in rotation as decoration. The frame and the drawings are left out of this edition; the twenty photographs are included. The photographs are printed in colour in the book; the scan shows them in brown and grey tones.
The book has no chapters, only sections separated by a small ornament. The contents entries and the page divisions of the web and EPUB editions, at those breaks, are the editor’s.
